03-15-1722 is March 15, 1722.  
17 weeks = 119 days. Plus 4 days = 123 days earlier.  
March 15 minus 123 days:  
March has 31 days, so March 15 → back 15 days to Feb 28 (1722 is not a leap year).  
Remaining 108 days: go into 1721.  
From Feb 28 back 31 days (Jan) → Jan 28, remaining 77 days.  
From Jan 28 back 31 days (Dec 1721) → Dec 28, remaining 46 days.  
From Dec 28 back 30 days (Nov) → Nov 28, remaining 16 days.  
From Nov 28 back 16 days → Nov 12, 1721.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1721-11-12
